-- Fix 74b (G4) after 73b: adopt the new SAP column SEVERITY, on our schedule.
-- 1) add it at the end of the L1 contract view, 2) preview the DT change with EXPLAIN CHANGES,
-- 3) apply it with CREATE OR ALTER (no drop, no gap for users), 4) record it in the contract.

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION
  comment = 'G1 contract view. 74b: SEVERITY adopted'
as select MAINTENANCENOTIFICATION::varchar as NOTIFICATION_ID,
          EQUIPMENT::varchar               as EQUIPMENT_ID,
          NOTIFICATIONTYPE::varchar        as NOTIFICATION_TYPE,
          PRIORITY::varchar                as PRIORITY,
          CREATEDON::date                  as CREATED_ON,
          DOWNTIMEHOURS::number(10,2)      as DOWNTIME_HOURS,
          'SAP'                            as PROVENANCE,
          SEVERITY::varchar                as SEVERITY
   from {{DEMO_L0}}.MAINTENANCE.MAINT_NOTIFICATION;

-- Preview: what will this DT change do to the next refresh (reinitialise or not)?
explain changes using text
create or alter dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME
  target_lag = '2 minutes' warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}} refresh_mode = incremental
  comment = 'Guarded L2: downtime by machine and month. Protected by ALERT_SCHEMA_GUARD.'
as select e.SITE, e.FLEET_TYPE, e.EQUIPMENT_ID, e.EQUIPMENT_NAME,
          date_trunc('month', n.CREATED_ON) as MONTH,
          count(*) as NOTIFICATIONS, sum(n.DOWNTIME_HOURS) as DOWNTIME_HOURS,
          count_if(n.SEVERITY = 'HIGH') as HIGH_SEVERITY_NOTIFICATIONS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION n
   join {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_EQUIPMENT e on e.EQUIPMENT_ID = n.EQUIPMENT_ID
   group by all;

create or alter dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME
  target_lag = '2 minutes' warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}} refresh_mode = incremental
  comment = 'Guarded L2: downtime by machine and month. Protected by ALERT_SCHEMA_GUARD.'
as select e.SITE, e.FLEET_TYPE, e.EQUIPMENT_ID, e.EQUIPMENT_NAME,
          date_trunc('month', n.CREATED_ON) as MONTH,
          count(*) as NOTIFICATIONS, sum(n.DOWNTIME_HOURS) as DOWNTIME_HOURS,
          count_if(n.SEVERITY = 'HIGH') as HIGH_SEVERITY_NOTIFICATIONS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION n
   join {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_EQUIPMENT e on e.EQUIPMENT_ID = n.EQUIPMENT_ID
   group by all;

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.L0_CONTRACT (TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, TYPE_SQL, ORDINAL_POSITION, L1_COLUMN, STATUS)
select TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, TYPE_SQL, ORDINAL_POSITION, 'SEVERITY', 'ADOPTED'
from {{DEMO_L0}}.SYNC.V_COLS
where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MAINTENANCE' and TABLE_NAME = 'MAINT_NOTIFICATION' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SEVERITY';

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('74b', 'FIX_APPLIED', 'G4', 'SEVERITY adopted: added to L1, previewed with EXPLAIN CHANGES, DT changed with CREATE OR ALTER (HIGH_SEVERITY_NOTIFICATIONS), contract updated', 'PRESENTER');
